response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack/systems engineer with 15+ years across web, embedded, and distributed systems, but his background shows no direct experience with experimentation platforms, feature flagging, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or growth engineering — the core focus of this role. His career trajectory (Senior/Staff titles, small-to-mid team scope) also does not clearly demonstrate the cross-team technical leadership and multi-workstream ownership expected at Principal/IC6 level.
strengths: Broad, deep technical range across languages (C, C++, C#, Java, TypeScript, DLang) and platforms (web, mobile, embedded)
Proven scale experience at Dunnhumby handling millions of HTTP requests/sec with low-latency, async systems
Long track record of technical craftsmanship, mentoring, workshops, and open-source platform building (GISCollective)
concerns: No evidence of experimentation/A/B testing platforms, feature flagging, or rollout-risk management experience
No demonstrated telemetry, metrics infrastructure, or data-driven growth engineering work
Career titles (Senior/Staff) and scope of ownership don't clearly match Principal/IC6 cross-team leadership expectations

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering fundamentals and scale experience
